primary.command_contract: Explicit argv only. Private writable selected-project snapshot at /workspace; /scratch is bounded. No network, host home, credentials or state. Bounded regular-file changes return as a changeset; a separate applied integration receipt confirms Workspace publication. Skills available at /skills/NAME. command_unguarded re-runs an identical failed command on the host only after the user approves it.
primary.file_tools: list (directory entries), read (UTF-8, zero-based byte offset, limit 1..65536, whole-file sha256), search (literal UTF-8 content in a file or directory; use Read or an include for edit sha256), mkdir (new directory; parent must exist), write (null digest only creates), edit (unique literal match, expected sha256)

researcher.file_tools: list (directory entries), read (UTF-8, zero-based byte offset, limit 1..65536, whole-file sha256), search (literal UTF-8 content in a file or directory)
